name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
summary: Alessandro Luca asks you to carry a Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity. The kit’s cost goes on the Society’s tab.

sections.title: A Ready Kit
sections.body: The kit is prepared, and Luca has a message for Apothecary Zinge. You carry it to her in the Undercity, along with the sender’s greetings. Its cost will be added to the Society’s tab.

faq.q: What am I carrying to Apothecary Zinge?
faq.answer: You are carrying a Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
The Field Sampling Kit is for Apothecary Zinge.
Alessandro Luca says the kit’s cost will be added to the Society’s tab.

faq.q: What message goes with the kit?
faq.answer: You are asked to give Apothecary Zinge the sender’s warm greetings.
